_about: Frame budget per traced action, in milliseconds, checked by test_driver/frame_budget_driver.dart. Build is the UI thread's work per frame. Measured on the CI emulator (API 30, software drawing, Reduce Transparency), which is no phone: these catch regressions; how it feels is checked on a real device. First passing run, 1.0.0-rc.1: home 3.5 ms p90 / 89 worst / 4.0% over 16 ms; photo grid 3.8 / 49 / 1.7%; calendar 1.7 / 120 / 2.9%. The limits are about twice that; the worst frame (a page load, a month change) is noisy, so it has the most room.
